fpu.title:
Steelwork for
FPU projects.
fpu.description: Steel renewal and modification for FPU structures, from workshop preparation to welding at the onboard work location.
fpu.detail: Affected sections are removed and replacement components prepared to the engineering drawings. Installation includes welding, grinding and finishing to suit the existing structure, with pipe supports and scaffolding arranged around the work.
fpu.poster_alt: Seafort marine and offshore company introduction
fpu.video_caption: An introduction to Seafort, with photographs from marine and offshore projects.
fpu.label: Discuss FPU Steelwork

capabilities.title:
The work behind
our services.
capabilities.description: See how steelwork, surface treatment and installation connect across the project.

items.title:
Steel renewal.
Structural repair.
items.body: Corroded or damaged sections are removed and renewed to the repair drawings. Workshop preparation leads into onboard welding, grinding and finishing.
items.image_alt: Welder working on an internal steel structure
items.label: Explore Repair Services

items.title:
Prepare the surface.
Protect the structure.
items.body: Tank and deck cleaning, washing and drying prepare the area for the specified treatment. Abrasive or mechanical preparation is followed by spray, brush, roller and local touch-up coating.
items.image_alt: Coating work from scaffold access on an offshore structure
items.label: Explore Coating Services

items.title:
Equipment foundations.
Onboard installation.
items.body: Fabricated foundations and supports connect equipment and modules to the structure. Installation brings together lifting, fitting and the associated piping or mechanical connections.
items.image_alt: Crane handling of a fabricated steel assembly
items.label: Discuss an Installation
